page.metaTitle: Free deadline check: TIE and Padrón for Barcelona students
page.metaDescription: Tell us your nationality and the date you entered Spain, and we’ll tell you the same day which route applies (EX-17 or EX-18), how many days are left on your window, and what is still recoverable. No charge, no card, no obligation.
page.title: Tell us your entry date. We’ll tell you how many days are left.
page.intro: Non-EU students normally have one month from entry to apply for the TIE, and the appointment is the part nobody can rush. Send the three documents and today you’ll know which route applies, what is still recoverable, and whether you need us at all.
steps: Which route applies to you — EX-17 or EX-18 — read from your own authorisation, not guessed from your passport
How many days you have left, counted from your entry stamp
What is still recoverable, and what has to happen first
Whether you need us at all. If you don’t, we’ll say so
page.declineNote: If your window has already closed, or you’re on an expired or irregular status, or facing a refusal — that needs legal analysis we are not qualified to give. We’ll tell you at triage and point you to a colegiado abogado. We’d rather lose the work than take your money for something we cannot fix.

fields.arrivedOnHint: The date on your entry stamp, not the date your course started.

housing.own-lease: A flat, with my name on the lease
housing.room-or-sublet: A room in a shared flat, or a sublet
housing.staying-with-someone: Staying with family or a friend

clock.open: On this entry date, your one-month window closes on {date} — about {days} days from today. Indicative: your own authorisation can state a different period, which is why we read it.
clock.closed: On this entry date, the ordinary one-month window closed about {days} days ago. Send it anyway — tell us below what happened, and we’ll tell you honestly whether it’s recoverable.
clock.eu: On an EU, EEA or Swiss passport there is no one-month clock. The registration duty starts at three months’ residence, so you have more room than you probably think.

uploads.title: The three documents
uploads.note: Optional, but they’re what makes the answer exact rather than general. PDF, JPEG or PNG, up to 10 MB each. Encrypted on arrival and deleted once your enquiry is answered.
uploads.entry-stamp: Your entry stamp, or boarding pass

form.consent: I agree that BCN Student Concierge may process what I’ve entered here, and any documents I attach, in order to answer this enquiry. Nothing here obliges me to buy anything.
form.freeNote: No charge, no obligation, no card. We reply the same day.
form.failed: Could not send your enquiry. Please try again.

done.title: We’ve got it.
done.body: Your reference is {ref}. We’ll reply to the email address you gave us today, with the route that applies, the days you have left, and what to do first.
done.note: If you didn’t attach the three documents, send them as a reply to that email. The answer gets more exact the more we can read. While you wait, the free guide covers the whole process end to end.

cta.title: Not sure where you stand? Find out for free.
cta.body: Send your entry stamp, your authorisation and your enrolment letter. We’ll tell you which route applies, how many days you have left, and what’s still recoverable. No charge, no obligation, and if you don’t need us we’ll say so.
cta.note: Same day. Fifteen minutes of your time.
